body:
Below freezing, the rain collected in collisions with cloud ice and snow freezes into snow at a rate limited by conductive removal of latent heat, approximated by the frozen fraction `1 - f_liq` (`f_liq` rises linearly from `0` at `temperature_rain_collision_snow` to `1` at `T_freeze`). Ice and snow melt in rain collisions only at and above freezing:
- **Cloud ice + rain:** Collected cloud ice forms snow below freezing (`S_accr_icl_rai`) and melts into rain at and above freezing (new term `S_accr_melt_icl_rai`); collected rain freezes with fraction `1 - f_liq` (`S_accr_freeze_icl_rai`, zero when warm).
- **Rain + snow:** Collected rain freezes onto snow with fraction `1 - f_liq` below freezing (`S_accr_rai_sno_cold`); at and above freezing, snow melts only by the sensible heat of the collected rain (`S_accr_melt_rai_sno`; `S_accr_rai_sno_warm` is removed).
title: Liquid-fraction ramp for the phase of rain collision products
